contexts.text: I will destroy them with the earth () = that the human race would perish with the Church. Explained.
That man could no longer so destroy himself. Signified.
For the will of man is utterly destroyed... AC 933:3. AC 8806:2.

Because we destroy this place () = that the state of evil in which they were would damn them. To destroy, when predicated of the Lord, = to perish by evil, that is, to be damned. It is frequently said in the Word that Jehovah destroys, but in the internal sense is meant that the man destroys himself; for Jehovah or the Lord destroys no one. Explained.

Jehovah hath sent us to destroy it () = that they cannot but perish... By this the good were saved, and the wicked perished; but the latter perished by this law, that the evil itself destroyed them... AC 2402.
The Knowledge of such things... is at this day entirely destroyed...
Hence, man is entirely destroyed as to both understanding and will.
That goods and truths were entirely destroyed with that posterity. Signified.

Evil Spirits... would then endeavour to destroy man in a thousand ways... They were in the continual endeavour to destroy me; not only as to the body, but especially as to the soul; for to destroy man and any Spirit is the very delight of life with those who are in Hell. AC 5864. HH 249. HH 292:2.
They desire nothing more than... to destroy those who do not favour them... for in the proportion that anyone is in hatred, he is in the delight of destroying; but in the world this is hidden.
The land was destroyed from before the hurtful flying thing () = that the natural mind was corrupted as to all truth. To be destroyed = to be corrupted.
The destroyer () = Hell, which inflicts damnation. AC 7929.
Upon everything that is lost () = everything ambiguous. Lost = everything to which there is injury or loss.
Snare, net, etc., = the destruction of spiritual life, and thus perdition; for the delights of these loves are what destroy, and are what destroy...
This (Sensuous) with man is entirely destroyed...
The Knowledge of correspondences has been entirely destroyed, and, with it, the Knowledge of Heaven.
(After death) they do not know that they have lost anything.
(Thus) they would wholly destroy themselves...
Before this Word... there was a Word which has been destroyed. General article.
The image of God and the likeness of God are not destroyed with man, but are as it were destroyed...
Under Abaddon, see this reference.
By Abaddon in the Hebrew text is meant perdition in the following places. Illustrated.
To destroy them that destroy the earth () = the casting into Hell of those who have destroyed the Church. AE 697.
How easy it is for Jehovah God to destroy the universal human race...
They grieved because the universe was not destroyed...
Without conscience they want to destroy the human race...
That certain Spirits continually endeavour to destroy man.
Wherefore, men lose nothing but the flesh and bones, and the use of that memory.
(He had) only the ends of destroying good and truth...
Man loses nothing (by death) of all his states...
To kill to destruction () = devastation.
The lion, and the destroyer of the nations () = falsity and evil laying waste.
The vastation of the Church is meant by they have destroyed and trampled My vineyard ().
Hence it may be evident, whence it is that this Sensuous is called Perdition, or Abaddon, and Apollyon.
Here, also (), to the belly are attributed destructions, i.e. evil thoughts.
To destroy, etc () = so to destroy that...
The destroyer of the nations () = the evil of falsity destroying the good of the Church.
The grave () = the Hell where and whence are evils; and destruction, the Hell where and whence are falsities.
